ReviewCycle.title: Review Cycle
ReviewCycle.description: The orchestration container for a performance-review round (jaargesprekken, beoordelingscyclus, or a tussentijds check-in). A cycle walks concept -> open -> gesloten; PerformanceReview objects reference an open cycle via cycleId. Deliberately generic (jaargesprek/beoordeling/tussentijds) so a future comp-planning cycle can reference cycles rather than reinvent them (ADR-001 Rule 6).

openen.description: Open the cycle for reviews. From this point PerformanceReview objects may reference this cycle as their in-progress round.

sluiten.description: Close the cycle. A closed cycle is history and is not reopened (the Vacancy no-resurrection precedent) -- a correction means starting a new cycle.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of the review cycle, e.g. "Jaargesprekken 2026".

type.title: Type
type.description: The kind of review round this cycle covers. Enum is append-only.

status.title: Status
status.description: Cycle workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: Planned start date of the review cycle.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Planned end date of the review cycle.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this ReviewCycle is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7); a cycle has no single employee to derive it from, so nl-administratie-scope-consistency does not evaluate this schema. Maintained by HR/back-office; the implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

PerformanceReview.title: Performance Review
PerformanceReview.description: A single employee's beoordelingsdossier for one review cycle: rating, sterktes/ontwikkelpunten/afspraken and goals, on a concept -> ingediend -> besproken -> vastgesteld lifecycle with a heropenen correction edge. Under BW 7:669 lid 3 sub d a documented, vastgestelde beoordeling with a rating and concrete afspraken is the precondition for any underperformance dismissal -- this object is that dossier. Goals are recorded INSIDE the review (no separate Goal entity, design D2): they freeze with the dossier under one lifecycle, one audit trail and one retention context.

indienen.description: The reviewer submits the draft verslag.

bespreken.description: The beoordelingsgesprek has taken place. besprokenOp is stamped on the carrying write.

vaststellen.description: The beoordeling is vastgesteld. NoSelfApprovalGuard denies the transition when the acting user equals employeeId -- the employee under review may not vaststellen their own beoordeling. vastgesteldDoor is stamped on the carrying write.

heropenen.description: Correction edge: a vastgesteld verslag that turns out wrong is reopened to besproken for correction. Every path back to vastgesteld passes the NoSelfApprovalGuard again.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: The employee under review. Drives the self-approval guard on vaststellen -- the acting user may not equal this employee.

cycleId.title: Review cycle
cycleId.description: Reference to the ReviewCycle this review belongs to.

reviewerId.title: Reviewer
reviewerId.description: Optional reference to the manager/Employee conducting the beoordelingsgesprek.

status.title: Status
status.description: Review workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Overall beoordeling rating. Nullable by design: a concept/ingediend review legitimately has no rating yet. A vastgesteld review without a rating is flagged by the nl-performance-dossiervorming audit rule, not blocked by the schema.

sterktes.title: Sterktes
sterktes.description: Free-text description of the employee's strengths discussed in the gesprek.

ontwikkelpunten.title: Ontwikkelpunten
ontwikkelpunten.description: Free-text description of development points discussed in the gesprek.

afspraken.title: Afspraken
afspraken.description: Concrete afspraken/verbetertraject agreed in the gesprek -- the BW 7:669 lid 3 sub d dossiervorming evidence. A vastgesteld review with empty afspraken is flagged by the nl-performance-dossiervorming audit rule.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Goals agreed as part of this review, recorded INSIDE the review rather than as a separate Goal entity (design D2) -- they freeze with the dossier under the same lifecycle, audit trail and retention context. A carried-over goal is re-entered in the next review; goals are not tracked across cycles in this MVP.

status.title: Status
status.description: The goal's own status, independent of the review's lifecycle.

toelichting.title: Toelichting
toelichting.description: Optional free-text explanation of the goal or its progress.

besprokenOp.title: Besproken op
besprokenOp.description: Date the beoordelingsgesprek took place. Stamped on the carrying write of the bespreken transition.

vastgesteldDoor.title: Vastgesteld door
vastgesteldDoor.description: Nextcloud user id of the manager who vaststelde the beoordeling -- an NC user id, not an object FK (the approvedBy convention), never a $ref. Stamped on the carrying write of the vaststellen transition. Must differ from the reviewed employee (no self-approval).

userId.title: User
userId.description: Denormalized Nextcloud user id of the employee this review belongs to (mijn-hr-self-service) -- a plain NC-user-id string, mirroring the Timesheet convention, never a $ref relation. A copy of the linked Employee's nextcloudUserId, carried here because the manifest filter grammar cannot join across schemas. The MijnBeoordelingen self-service page filters on it with the @me token.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this PerformanceReview is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring the reviewed employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.
